To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed method is capable to compute a 'black box'' non linear dynamic model of a complex dynamical system, in this case a low pressure subsystem onboard a climbing robot, and that the proposed method can be applied to other similar systems.
a 'black box', neural network model has been computed to predict the low pressure subsystem dynamics of the Alicia II robot.
a Neural Network model for the low-pressure subsystem of the robot has been successfully computed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of a non linear dynamic model of the low pressure subsystem by using Neural Network methodology.
the development of a neural network model to predict the pressure inside the base module of a climbing robot.
the development of a neural network based model of a low pressure subsystem, which is a crucial part of the base module of a climbing robot.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach is a valid alternative to the traditional identification methods.
the neural network model is a good model to predict the pressure of the robot cup.
the Neural Network model obtained is a valid alternative for a non linear model for the low-pressure subsystem onboard the base of the Alicia II robot.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to identify the dynamics of a complex non linear system by using a Neural Network model.
the obtained model can be used to predict the pressure value inside the cup, by using as input the values of the pressure inside the base module and the temperature of the environment.
the model obtained can be used for the pressure control inside the cup of Alicia II.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a neural network can be successfully applied to the system identification task for a non linear dynamical system.
the Neural Network model has been able to reproduce the behaviour of the low pressure subsystem in terms of pressure inside the cup and the volume of the air inside the cup.
Neural Network methodology can be successfully applied to model non linear dynamical systems with good results.
